name: io.github.theYahia/kaiten-mcp
title: Kaiten
description: Kaiten kanban - spaces, boards, cards, checklists, comments, sprints (Russia)

environmentVariables.name: KAITEN_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Kaiten subdomain (acme) or full host (acme.kaiten.io); not needed if KAITEN_BASE_URL is set

environmentVariables.name: KAITEN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token from Kaiten Profile > API tokens

environmentVariables.name: KAITEN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base for self-hosted Kaiten, e.g. https://kaiten.mycorp.ru/api/latest
